$schema: 任务书 JSON 模板（fr-flow v3）
feature: 债券业务管理系统前端加壳（7 页 + 数据层）

database.note: 帆软命名连接 common_db（指向 MySQL common_db 库，root 账号）存在；本工程所有 whjrscbmanage 库表 SQL 一律以 `whjrscbmanage.` 前缀跨库访问（whjyx 同款做法）。两个字典数据集走 install 连接 `assign`。

datasets.name: declare_list
datasets.sql: SELECT b.id, b.biz_uuid, b.bond_code, b.customer_no, b.customer_name, b.biz_name, b.bond_type, b.green_tech_flag, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM whjrscbmanage.bus_bond_business b WHERE b.status IN (0, 2) AND b.creator = '${p_operator}' AND ('' = '${p_customer_name}' OR b.customer_name = '${p_customer_name}') ORDER BY b.id DESC

datasets.name: declare_customer_opt
datasets.sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.customer_name FROM whjrscbmanage.bus_bond_business b WHERE b.status IN (0, 2) AND b.creator = '${p_operator}' AND b.customer_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.customer_name

datasets.name: schedule_by_bond
datasets.sql: SELECT b.id, b.biz_uuid, b.bond_code, b.sort, b.repayment_date, b.repayment_amount, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM whjrscbmanage.bus_repayment_schedule b WHERE b.bond_code = '${p_bond_code}' AND b.status = 2 ORDER BY b.sort

datasets.name: schedule_of_business
datasets.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(',', CONCAT('还款时间:', IFNULL(b.repayment_date,'无')), CONCAT('还款金额:', IFNULL(b.repayment_amount,'无'))) SEPARATOR ';') AS repayment_info, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('installmentTime', DATE_FORMAT(b.repayment_date,'%Y-%m-%d'), 'installmentAmount', CAST(b.repayment_amount AS UNSIGNED))) AS installment_list FROM whjrscbmanage.bus_bond_business bbb LEFT JOIN whjrscbmanage.bus_repayment_schedule b ON b.bond_code = bbb.bond_code AND b.status = 2 WHERE bbb.biz_uuid = '${p_biz_uuid}'

datasets.name: config_get
datasets.sql: SELECT * FROM whjrscbmanage.bus_upper_storage_config ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

datasets.name: pool_list_mine
datasets.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.id, b.biz_uuid, b.bond_code, b.ecif_customer_no, b.customer_no, b.customer_name, b.biz_name, b.bond_type, b.biz_type, b.green_tech_flag, b.ext_rating, b.ext_rating_date, b.rating_agency, b.int_rating, b.int_rating_date, b.industry, b.customer_type, b.alert_customer, b.start_date, b.mature_date, b.currency, b.orig_amount, b.rmb_amount, b.balance, b.invest_rate, b.transfer_rate, b.guarantee_info, b.breach_flag, b.five_level_class, b.fund_used_flag, b.fund_used_up, b.installment_flag, b.installment_plan, b.our_bank_underwrite, b.lead_underwriter, b.manage_line, b.dept, b.agreed_usage, b.fund_account, b.fund_account_flag, b.supervise_account, b.supervise_account_flag, b.drawdown_check, b.is_original_am, b.exercise_flag, b.exercise_date, b.remark, b.js_remark, b.js_remark_flag, b.inspect_freq, b.inspector_post, b.creator, b.org_code, b.org_name, b.status, b.termination_reason, b.create_time, b.update_time, b.remark_number, b.is_passage, b.passage_amount, b.upper_storage_rate, CONCAT(w.user_name, '(', b.creator, ')') AS related_name, wb.dept_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.id DESC) AS rn FROM whjrscbmanage.bus_bond_business b LEFT JOIN whjrscbmanage.whfr_user w ON b.creator = w.user_id LEFT JOIN whjrscbmanage.whoa_branch_info wb ON b.org_code = wb.branch_no WHERE b.creator = '${p_operator}' AND b.status != '5' AND b.status != '6' AND ('' = '${p_customer_name}' OR b.customer_name = '${p_customer_name}') AND ('' = '${p_biz_name}' OR b.biz_name LIKE CONCAT('%','${p_biz_name}','%')) AND ('' = '${p_status}' OR b.status = '${p_status}') ) t3 WHERE t3.rn > ('${p_pageno}' - 1) * '${p_pagesize}' AND t3.rn <= '${p_pageno}' * '${p_pagesize}'
